messages:
Megan (PM): Ok team — proposing an MVP scope freeze to hit the milestone on 04/08. Long story short: move the advanced indexing pipeline + SSO integration to v1, deliver a simplified search + email auth for MVP. Need eng + SRE sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

Megan (PM): Proposed cuts: 
- deferred: nearline heavy indexing job (v1)
- deferred: enterprise SSO (v1)
- deferred: multi-tenant billing UI (v1)
- keep: core text gen, chat flow, basic search, embeddings endpoint

Alex (Eng): Quick thought — deferring indexing saves ~2 sprint-weeks but will increase read load on the cache. Can we ship with a reduced TTL for cached results as a stopgap?

Priya (Eng-ML): Agree with cutoff. Also recommend we skip model quantization experiments for MVP (move to v1). That buys us approx 7d of infra + validation. We should add a smoke prompt set to monitor quality.

Jordan (Eng-SRE): Cache TTL tweak is fine. If we reduce parallel workers for indexing, we need to adjust the autoscaler min replicas to avoid cold-start latency. I'll set a temporary policy: min_replicas=2, scale_window=60s. :heavy_check_mark:

Ben (Design): For SSO -> v1, we should surface a clear message in the auth flow: "Enterprise SSO coming soon — contact sales" so customers don't get confused. I can wire a small banner and update the empty-state copy.

Taylor (Product Ops): When you say "freeze by Thu" — is that freeze for feature acceptance, or final cut list? We need the release checklist aligned (QA, docs, release notes).

Megan (PM): Freeze = final cut list for MVP. After freeze we still do bug fixes + docs. Action items: 
- Alex: implement cache TTL change + confirm perf impact (owner) — due 1765432400 (48h)
- Jordan: temp autoscaler policy, and update runbook for warmup — due 1765432320 (24h)
- Priya: prepare smoke prompt set and quality monitor dashboard — due 1765432400
- Ben: banner + empty-state copy — due 1765432300 (tomorrow morning)
- Taylor: update release checklist and coordinate QA slots — due 1765432360

Alex (Eng): I'll also add a lightweight fallback: if the cache miss rate > 15% we route search traffic to read-only replicas. Will post the config snippet here.

deploy-bot: build/1765 queued for staging (sha: a3f2c9)

Jordan (Eng-SRE): Noted — will include the fallback in runbook. If anyone thinks the 15% threshold is too low, speak now.

Priya (Eng-ML): 15% is fine for MVP, but let's monitor end-to-end P95 latency. If >1.2s we should revert heavy traffic to smaller chimera model.

Megan (PM): Good. Consensus seems OK. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll adopt this cut list and move to freeze. Final sync Thursday 10:30am to validate QA pass and rollout plan.

Alex (Eng): :thumbsup:

Ben (Design): :thumbsup:

Taylor (Product Ops): Will schedule QA blocks and send calendar invites.

Megan (PM): I'll update the milestone tracker and ping stakeholders after freeze. Thanks all.
